newsitem.title: UK: EBRD arranges $23.1 mln Russian real estate loan.
newsitem.headline: EBRD arranges $23.1 mln Russian real estate loan.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) said on Monday it had arranged a $23.1 million debt financing package for the refurbishment of one of St. Petersburg's premier addresses, Nesky Prospekt 25, into office space.
OAO St. Petersburg Property Development Co will receive the loans, the largest limited recourse debt package assembled for a Russian real estate project, it said in a statement.
It will provide $6.4 million, the Overseas Private Investment Corporation $13.5 million, and two Russian firms the balance. -- London Newsroom +171 542 8682
